_comment: PAF model pricing table — maintained by the factory, used by the cost-reporting helper. USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Cache rates follow the documented multipliers: cache write (5m TTL) = 1.25x input, cache write (1h TTL) = 2x input, cache read = 0.1x input. Model keys MUST be dateless ('claude-haiku-4-5', never 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'): the helper strips a trailing -YYYYMMDD snapshot date before lookup, because pricing is per model and not per snapshot, so a dated key could never match.
_source: https://claude.com/pricing#api and Claude API pricing reference (claude-api skill), captured 2026-08-01
_usd_to_eur_source: ECB euro reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates) — maintained; update alongside the model rates. Captured 2026-06-08.

claude-sonnet-5._note: Introductory pricing $2.00 input / $10.00 output per MTok runs through 2026-08-31; standard rates listed here.

claude-opus-5._note: Fast mode (speed: fast) is billed at $10.00 input / $50.00 output per MTok; the ledger does not distinguish speeds, so a fast-mode run is under-priced here.
